Gota Cola - Wavelength's Phase (You won't have heard of 'em, but they were magnificent!)

Perhaps I'm the only one who adored this band beyond measure, but they'd just turn up randomly in small, dark, smoky, groovy Brisbane bars and do their thing... and it was transcendental.

And when they played, everyone was silent... just enjoying their friends and the night and the moments of 2001 captured in time.

That's one of the biggest things I recall about this band, the way the room was silent and EVERYONE was transfixed on them as they played. When their set ended and they took a break, you could hear a pin drop, you could identify the first person in the bar to break from the trance and start talking to their friends and before people started moving around. It was a special time that I wish more people got a chance to experience.

'Was lucky enough to get one of the few CDs they produced.

Let me know if anyone would like me to share some more.

This post is effectively the one last chance in all the world that you'll have a chance to experience this band... so please take the opportunity and take a moment to enjoy it.
